prompt.project_info: Ultra-high-definition ethereal high-fashion close-up with a muted pastel Paris-light palette.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with a serene dreamy gaze, soft parted lips, visible pores, natural freckles, and matte-finish skin. Her soft elegant updo has individual wispy windswept strands and high-gloss straight highlights. She wears an avant-garde body-hugging evening gown in deep wine red with intricate floral embroidery and its original dramatic V neckline; the tailored fit complements her feminine silhouette.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 tight close-up at a 60-degree lateral head tilt. Keep sharp focus on iris and eyelashes, an uncrowded creamy bokeh background, and no text, logo, watermark, or public-figure likeness.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft Paris daylight setup with warm rim lighting that catches the hair texture. Muted pastels, cream, and natural skin tones create an ethereal dreamy high-fashion atmosphere; gentle directional light creates realistic shadows along the gown's silhouette.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, tight close-up, 8K UHD, subtle film grain, professional color grade, highly photorealistic texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-high-definition 9:16 photography of an adult woman in a tight close-up with an 85mm prime lens, 60-degree lateral head tilt, shallow f/1.8 depth of field, creamy bokeh, and sharp focus on the iris and eyelashes. Serene dreamy gaze, soft parted lips, hyper-realistic skin texture with visible pores and natural freckles, matte finish, high-shine pink-nude glossy lipstick with subtle liner, long separated lashes, and subtle earth-tone eyeshadow. Soft elegant messy hair with individual wispy windswept strands catching warm rim light. Preserve the deep wine-red avant-garde body-hugging evening gown with intricate floral embroidery and dramatic V neckline; its tailored fit complements her feminine silhouette. Soft Paris daylight setup, muted pastels, cream, natural skin tones, ethereal dreamy high-fashion aesthetic, 8K UHD, professional color grading, subtle film grain, intricate photorealistic details.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity or public-figure likeness, sexualized pose, body-part emphasis, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No person reference is required. If an approved adult identity reference is attached, preserve face, facial structure, and likeness without substituting any celebrity or public figure. A wardrobe reference is optional; preserve its wine-red embroidered evening-gown silhouette and neckline. Hair, background, and lighting may be replaced only while retaining the tight close-up and ethereal high-fashion direction.
